spans.s: Covetousness, avarice, greed, cupidity; लोभश्चेदगुणेन किम्
; परवित्तादिकं दृष्ट्वा नेतुं यो हृदि जायते । अभिलाषो द्विजश्रेष्ठ स लोभः परिकीर्तितः Padma P.
Desire for, longing after (with gen. or in comp.); कङ्कणस्य तु लोभेन
Avarice personified (one of the six enemies of man).
Perplexity, confusion. -Comp. -अन्वित a. covetous, greedy, avaricious. -अभिपातिन् a. rushing greedily.-आत्मन् a. greedy-minded, avaricious. -मोहित a. beguiled by avarice. -विरहः absence of avarice;
लोभन [lōbhana], a. (-नी f.) Alluring, enticing. -नम् [लुभ्- ल्युट्]
लोभनीय [lōbhanīya] लोभ्य [lōbhya], लोभ्य a. Enticing, alluring, attractive; कुसुममिव लोभनायं यौवनमङ्गेषु संनद्धम् Ś.1.21;6.19.
लोभित [lōbhita], p. p. Allured, attracted, enticed, seduced.
लोभिन् [lōbhin], a. (At the end of comp.)
Greedy or desirous of, longing for, eager after.
